captureFailed.apiMessage: You are accessing Lighter from a restricted jurisdiction. For more information, see the https://lighter.xyz/terms
captureFailed.note: The WebSocket upgrade is refused before any frame is exchanged. A plain HTTPS GET to the same stream URL returns HTTP 400 with the code-20558 body above, which is the only way to see the real reason -- a failed upgrade carries no payload. Browser-like User-Agent and Origin headers make no difference; this is jurisdiction, not bot detection. Re-run this capture from a permitted jurisdiction to populate the fixtures.
